releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b60
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b60 — Stable Release

STABLE RELEASE · BUILD 60

This release introduces a redesigned application launch experience, improved loading feedback, updated splash-screen visuals, and startup reliability improvements.

✨ What's New

1. Redesigned Splash Screen

- Completely redesigned the application opening screen.
- Added a refreshed full-screen visual experience.
- Improved logo presentation with animation and subtle visual effects.
- Added the application name: What Next?
- Introduced the new tagline: Your list. Your next pick.
- Added a descriptive footer: Pick, track and discover with AniList.
- Introduced a new dark purple gradient background.
- Improved spacing and layout for modern mobile screens.

2. Live Loading Progress Bar

- Introduced a new animated loading progress indicator.
- Displays loading progress while application resources are being loaded.
- Progress updates as individual screen components and JavaScript modules finish loading.
- Added smooth progress animations.
- Improved visual feedback during application startup.

3. Startup Improvements

- Updated application resource revision to "2.1.1-r15".
- Updated service worker cache version.
- Improved resource cache invalidation.
- Helps prevent outdated application files from being mixed with newly updated resources.
- Improved handling of the splash screen during application initialisation.

4. Mobile Experience & Accessibility

- Improved splash-screen layout for different mobile screen dimensions.
- Added safe-area spacing support.
- Improved small-screen compatibility.
- Respects reduced-motion preferences.
- Preserved the option to disable the opening splash screen through App Settings.

5. Testing & Quality Improvements

- Added automated splash-screen end-to-end tests.
- Tested loading progress behaviour.
- Added mobile viewport layout checks.
- Tested splash-screen visibility and dismissal.
- Verified that disabling the splash screen still allows normal application startup.
- Added checks for JavaScript errors during loading.

---

✅ Stable Release

What Next? v2.1.1-b60 is now available as a stable release.

This update focuses on improving the first impression, application startup experience, and overall interface polish.

Thank you for being part of What Next!

Your list. Your next pick.

Developed by Tokyo Brotherhood.

---

Full Changelog:

https://github.com/tokyo720022-create/What-Next/compare/v2.1.1-b57...v2.1.1-b60

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b57
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b57 — Stable Release

STABLE RELEASE · BUILD 57

A major update to What Next! This release brings a redesigned user experience, personalised Anime and Manga discovery, a new Taste Report system, expanded Profile functionality, and several quality-of-life improvements.

✨ Major New Features

1. Personalised Taste Report

Introducing a detailed system that analyses your AniList activity to understand your Anime and Manga preferences.

- Personalised Anime and Manga taste analysis.
- Unique taste archetypes based on your strongest interests.
- Four-letter personality classification.
- Theme Index comparing your preferences against the average AniList user.
- Five interactive-style preference indicators:
  - Grim / Wholesome
  - Heart / Brain
  - Dreamers / Schemers
  - Scrappy / Destined
  - Competitive / Loyal
- Discover hidden gems based on your viewing history.
- Explore older classics and newer releases.
- Genre distribution and preference analysis.
- Identify your biggest rating differences compared with other fans.
- Share your personal Taste Report.

2. Something New for My Taste

A new recommendation system designed to find titles outside your existing AniList collection.

- Personalised Anime and Manga recommendations.
- Uses your favourite genres and strongest themes.
- Excludes titles already present in your AniList lists.
- Filters out unreleased titles.
- Integrates with your existing Watch, Read, Genre, Time and 18+ filters.
- Added Another and Hide options.
- Directly add discoveries to your AniList Planning list.

3. Redesigned Profile

A completely refreshed Profile experience.

- Redesigned profile banner and avatar layout.
- Improved Anime, Manga, Following and Followers statistics.
- Added Anime and Manga Tendencies.
- Automatic genre preference analysis.
- Favourite tags and release-year insights.
- First recorded watching/reading year.
- Completion-rate analysis.
- New Favourites section featuring:
  - Anime
  - Manga
  - Characters
  - Staff
  - Studios
- Added Show More pagination.
- Improved navigation to Stats, Chat and Settings.

🎨 New Anime Themes

Introduced eight dedicated themes to personalise the entire application.

1. Sakura Flowers 🌸
2. One Piece ☠️
3. Naruto 🍥
4. Gintama
5. Dragon Ball
6. Bleach
7. Rent-a-Girlfriend
8. Attack on Titan

Special visual treatments include Sakura petal effects and Gintama-inspired Edo wave patterns.

All themes come with their own background, colour palette, accent colours and interface styling.

📚 Anime & Manga List Improvements

- Added AniList Custom Lists integration.
- Automatically detects your custom lists.
- Displays the number of titles inside each custom list.
- Filter Anime and Manga collections by individual custom lists.
- Added an All Lists option.
- Custom list filtering works alongside existing status filters and search.

🔄 Swipe Down to Refresh

Introduced a pull-to-refresh system with an animated visual indicator.

Supported screens:

- Pick
- Anime and Manga Lists
- Discover
- Seasonal
- Calendar
- Schedule
- Profile
- Stats
- Taste Report
- Chat

Refresh your content without manually reloading the application.

🧠 Smarter Recommendation System

- Improved release-date detection.
- Prevents unreleased titles from appearing in recommendations.
- Avoids suggesting anime episodes that have not aired yet.
- Added New for You identification.
- Improved personalised recommendation selection.
- Added direct Add to Planning functionality for new discoveries.

⚙️ General Improvements

- Updated application loading sequence.
- Improved resource and cache version management.
- Refined interface styling across multiple screens.
- Improved Profile presentation and navigation.
- Expanded automated testing.
- Added new end-to-end tests for major features.
- Added additional unit tests for Taste Report calculations.
- Improved overall application consistency.

---

✅ Stable Release

What Next? v2.1.1-b57 is now a stable release.

Thank you for using What Next!

Your Anime and Manga journey, your collection, and your next discovery — all in one place.

What Next? — Discover what to watch or read next.

Developed by Tokyo Brotherhood.

---

Full Changelog:

https://github.com/tokyo720022-create/What-Next/compare/v2.1.1-b47...v2.1.1-b57

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b54
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b54 — Pre-release

<badge>PRE-RELEASE · BUILD 54</badge>

This update introduces a redesigned Profile experience, smarter taste-based recommendations, AniList custom-list filtering, and a new swipe-to-refresh system.

✨ What's New

1. Redesigned Profile

- Redesigned Profile interface with a new banner, avatar, and improved layout.
- Added a dedicated Tendencies section for Anime and Manga.
- Automatically analyses your AniList statistics to identify:
  - Most-loved genres.
  - Least-favoured genres (when enough data is available).
  - Frequently encountered tags.
  - Favourite release years.
  - First recorded watching/reading year.
  - Overall completion rate.
- Added a new Favourites section with separate categories:
  - Anime
  - Manga
  - Characters
  - Staff
  - Studios
- Added pagination with a Show More option.
- Favourite entries now open their respective media or entity pages.
- Improved Profile navigation with redesigned Stats, Chat, and Settings shortcuts.

2. Something New for My Taste

- Added a new Something New for My Taste button in the Pick section.
- Generates personalised Anime and Manga recommendations based on your AniList taste report.
- Matches recommendations against your favourite genres and themes.
- Excludes titles already present in your AniList lists.
- Filters out unreleased titles.
- Selects recommendations from the strongest matches to provide variety.
- Added an Add to Planning action for new discoveries.
- Supports Another and Hide actions.

Note: Taste-based recommendations require at least 8 non-planning entries for the selected media type.

3. Custom Lists Support

- Added a new Custom Lists button in Anime and Manga lists.
- Automatically detects your AniList custom lists.
- Displays the number of titles in each custom list.
- Filter your collection by individual custom lists.
- Added an All Lists option to restore the complete collection.

4. Swipe Down to Refresh

- Introduced a new pull-to-refresh interaction with an animated indicator.
- Refreshes the current screen without requiring a manual page reload.
- Supported screens include:
  - Pick
  - Anime and Manga Lists
  - Discover
  - Seasonal
  - Calendar
  - Schedule
  - Profile
  - Stats
  - Taste Report
  - Chat

5. Smarter Recommendations & Improvements

- Improved release-date detection using AniList media status and start dates.
- Prevents unreleased titles from appearing in normal recommendations.
- Better handling of upcoming episodes and available progress.
- Added a New for You label for personalised discoveries.
- New discoveries offer Add to Planning instead of Mark as Done.
- Improved recommendation flow and reuse of cached taste calculations.
- Updated application resource loading and cache versioning.

6. Testing & Development

- Added new automated end-to-end tests for:
  - Custom Lists
  - Taste-based recommendations
  - Profile and Favourites
  - Swipe-to-refresh functionality
- Expanded Profile Tendencies unit tests.
- Improved test coverage for the new features.

---

🚧 Pre-release Notice

This is an experimental pre-release build intended for testing and feedback.

Some features may undergo further changes, and unexpected bugs or incomplete behaviour may occur.

Please report bugs, UI issues, and suggestions through GitHub Issues.

Thank you for testing What Next!

More improvements are on the way.

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b47
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b47

🚀 What's New

🧠 New Anime & Manga Taste Report

Discover your personal anime and manga preferences with the new Taste Report, accessible from the Pick screen.

- Taste Archetype: Discover your dominant anime or manga theme.
- Theme Index: See which themes you prefer more or less than the average AniList fan.
- Personality Type: Get a four-letter profile based on your preferences for niche vs. mainstream, retro vs. fresh, diverse vs. specialized, and contrarian vs. aligned.
- Hidden Gems: Discover titles that match your unique tastes.
- Genre Mix: Explore the distribution of your favourite genres.
- Rating Differences: Compare your ratings with other fans and find titles where your opinions differ.
- Vibe Sliders: Explore five dimensions of your preferences, from grim vs. wholesome to competitive vs. loyal.
- Share Your Taste: Share your personal taste report.

📊 Personalized Recommendations

The Taste Report compares your AniList collection against popular titles to help you better understand your preferences and discover recommendations that suit your taste.

Requirements: The report needs at least 8 started or completed titles. The Contrarian personality slider requires at least 8 rated titles.

🛠️ Additional Updates

- Added dedicated Taste Report screen styling and functionality.
- Added unit tests for Taste Report calculations.
- Updated project documentation.
- Added the "site.zip" archive to the repository.

🔄 Full Changelog

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b44
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b44

Discover more. Track your progress. Find your next favourite.

This release brings a major upgrade to the discovery experience, introduces new ways to explore seasonal anime and airing schedules, and improves the statistics dashboard with more detailed progress tracking.

✨ What's New

🔎 Redesigned Discover Experience

- Live Search: Search automatically as you type, without needing a separate search button.
- Multiple Search Categories: Explore anime, manga, characters, staff, studios, and AniList users from one unified interface.
- Explore Mode: Discover ranked results even when the search box is empty.
- Advanced Filters: Filter by genres, tags, year, season, format, status, country, source, list membership, and adult-content settings.
- Improved List Awareness: See real AniList list statuses and add eligible titles directly to Planning.

📅 Seasonal Anime Explorer

- Explore seasonal anime for different years and seasons.
- Browse titles grouped by format.
- Sort and reorder seasonal results.
- Filter titles to show only series already on your AniList list, or hide those titles.

🗓️ Airing Calendar

- Explore anime airing on a selected day.
- View scheduled airing times and countdowns.
- Check your AniList list status for each title.
- Access available streaming links.
- Filter the calendar to focus on your Watching and Planning lists or the current season.

🎯 Personalized Discovery

- For You: Explore trending titles that match your favourite genres and are not already on your list.
- Rediscover: Revisit paused and dropped anime or manga, prioritised by your ratings.

📊 Enhanced Progress Dashboard

- View your daily goal, completion ring, and current streak.
- Track activity over the last seven days with a progress chart.
- Access a Continue list with convenient progress-update buttons.
- Review your remaining backlog.
- Improve daily tracking by including eligible AniList activity from other apps, subject to your AniList activity settings.

⚙️ Navigation & Experience Improvements

- Improved Android back-button handling for discovery sheets, user menus, Seasonal, and Calendar.
- Better integration of the new discovery screens with the existing navigation.
- Updated application asset loading and offline cache revision to help devices load the latest files consistently.

📱 Download

Download "WhatNext-v2.1.1-b44.apk" from the Assets section below.

For the best experience, install the latest build and sign in with your AniList account to access your library, personalized discovery, and progress tracking.

🔗 Project Links

- Source Code: https://github.com/tokyo720022-create/What-Next
- All Releases: https://github.com/tokyo720022-create/What-Next/releases
- AniList: https://anilist.co/

---

What Next? is an unofficial AniList companion application developed by Tokyo Brotherhood. It helps users discover anime and manga, manage their lists, monitor progress, and explore their interests.

Disclaimer: What Next? is not affiliated with or endorsed by AniList.

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b43
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b43

A smarter way to discover what to watch or read next.

This release introduces new social features, enhanced user profiles, deeper anime and manga statistics, and improvements to the Android release workflow.

✨ New Features

People & Social Profiles

- Followers and Following: Browse your followers and the users you follow directly within the app.
- Mutual Follow Indicators: Easily identify users who follow you back.
- User Profiles: View other AniList users' profile banners, avatars, bios, anime and manga statistics, and profile information.
- Follow & Unfollow: Manage your connections directly from user profiles and the contextual menu.
- Direct Messaging: Open a conversation with another AniList user through the app's existing chat integration.
- AniList Integration: Quickly access users' original AniList profiles.

🎯 Anime & Manga Taste Affinity

- Compare your ratings with another user's ratings for titles you both have scored.
- View an affinity percentage based on the similarity of your shared ratings.
- Affinity calculations require at least five shared scored titles.
- View separate anime and manga affinity results.

📊 Detailed User Statistics

- Explore another user's detailed AniList statistics.
- View visual breakdowns of genres, statuses, demographics, formats, tags, and score distributions.
- Reuse the app's existing statistics presentation for a consistent experience.

⚙️ Android & Release Improvements

- Introduced uniquely versioned APK releases.
- Improved Android version-code generation to support installation of newer builds over earlier versions.
- Updated the build workflow to use a consistent signing identity across builds.
- Improved build concurrency handling and ZIP-upload workflow coordination.

📱 Download

🔗 Project Links

- Repository: https://github.com/tokyo720022-create/What-Next

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1 APK
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1 APK

Your personal AniList companion for anime and manga tracking.

What Next? helps you decide what to watch or read next based on your available time, while providing convenient access to your AniList library, statistics, and progress tracking.

✨ Features

- Smart Picks: Get anime and manga recommendations from your AniList lists based on your available time.
- Anime & Manga Library: Browse your lists with status tabs, search, sorting, advanced filters, and customizable layouts.
- Discover: Explore trending, popular, top-rated, and recently released anime and manga.
- Progress Tracking: Update episode and chapter progress, change list statuses, manage scores, and mark titles as completed.
- Detailed Media Pages: Explore synopses, genres, characters, staff, studios, relations, recommendations, and other title information.
- Anime & Manga Statistics: View detailed statistics, genre distributions, score breakdowns, and progress insights.
- Airing Schedule: Track upcoming episodes of airing anime from your list.
- Relation Map: Explore franchise connections, prequels, sequels, side stories, and related titles through an interactive map.
- Theme Customization: Choose light, dark, AMOLED, or custom colors.
- Offline Support: Access previously saved lists and use supported features when your internet connection is unavailable.
- AniList Chat: Access AniList's private messaging functionality from within the app.
- Discord Sync: Share anime and manga list updates with configured Discord forum threads.

📱 Android APK

Download the APK from the Assets section below to install What Next? on your Android device.

Note: Sign in with your AniList account to access your personal library and account features.
